en: \[VSCode] Fixed the Hooks and Permission rules dialogs reporting a save that landed as failed, and the Hooks dialog going blank under a plugin-only policy lock or showing color codes in save errors
zh: \[VSCode] 修复 Hooks 和 Permission rules 对话框将已成功的保存报告为失败的问题，以及 Hooks 对话框在仅 plugin 策略锁定下变为空白或在保存错误中显示颜色代码的问题
